ta453_campaigns.campaign_name: TA453 Aaron Stein Iraq's position in the Arab world campaign
ta453_campaigns.targeting_evidence: The threat actor sent a targeted email to a specific academic/researcher, impersonating a known contact and referencing a Middle East-related affair.

roles.role_impersonated: Aaron Stein (Director of Research at FPRI) and Richard Wike (Director of Global attitudes research at PEW Research Center)

ta453_campaigns.request: Answer intelligence questions regarding Iraq's position in the Arab world and the Abraham Accords, or agree to a Zoom meeting.
ta453_campaigns.pretext: The sender is allegedly working on an article about Iraq's position in the Arab world and is seeking expert comments to air to the public.

ta453_campaigns.target: Academics involved in nuclear arms control

roles.role_impersonated: Carroll Doherty (Director of Political Research at Pew Research Center) and Aaron Stein (Director of Research at FPRI)
